question: In a certain code language, 'BIB' is coded as '36', 'BOG' is coded as '210'. What is the code for 'EBB' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BIB' is coded as '36'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ad88396391ab18d9e8ae1119d5dc88c82600b90131da0cc0853d3504c46b1bc.png] 

And,

'BOG' is coded as '210'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/859e3f4d46e8467b8aa1a8156f1132b5cd19c0a51e0be60ff06655337c15e5c3.png] 

Similarly,

'EBB' is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec6429ad24fbe2c5f5a75b04dedc529ce27e34f71326b201984590f485666cf8.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
